content:
maria: Morning — RC cutover scheduled tomorrow 08:00 PT. Can CI team run a final green-sweep on release/2.4.x and hold version bump until we confirm? Also need last changelog pass. tagging @jon @sasha
jon: On it. I'll queue a full CI sweep now. Anyone seen flaky in e2e/streaming? We had a failure yesterday.
ci-bot: Queued: branch=release/2.4.x, job=full-green-sweep, id=ci-78291. Will post results.
sasha: I can do changelog pass today — will review PR list and ping authors for small callouts.
kevin: Re: e2e/streaming - saw intermittent 504s on gpu-nodes after ~1000 tokens. Flaky reproduction script attached:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/model -d '{"prompt":"long sequence test"}' || echo "fail $i"; sleep 0.5; done
```
ashok: If it's GPU related, maybe reduce batch size for the e2e smoke. I'll add a temporary env override in the CI job: BATCH_SIZE=2
jon: CI result: 5/128 flaky tests failed, most around e2e/streaming and integration/kvcache. Uploading links: https://ci.internal/ci-78291/results
maria: Thanks. @ashok @kevin can you triage top 3 failures before 18:00 PT? If not, we should still proceed with cutover but pin an earlier runtime that avoids the regression.
kevin: I can take the streaming flakes. Found a regression in runtime v1.9.2 -> v1.10.0 related to kernel selection. Bisecting now.
ci-bot: CI update: ci-78291 finished - overall: unstable. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/ci-78291/artifacts
jon: Proposal: hold version bump until we have green sweep or a documented rollback plan. If we must bump, do rc2 tag but with canary rollout 10% for 2 hours.
maria: Agree. Action items: 1) kevin - triage streaming flakes by 1800 PT 2) sasha - finalize changelog by 1500 PT 3) jon - prepare canary rollout plan. Ping here when done.
tara: Quick note: release notes need to include known issue about latency regressions on long sequences. I'll draft a short blurb and PR it.
jon: :thumbsup: putting canary rollout doc in https://git.internal/redwood/release/2.4/canary.md
kevin: Found culprit: kernel selector fallback path not hitting quantized op. Fix in PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/451 small patch. Running local e2e - looks good so far.
ci-bot: Triggered re-run for ci-78291-rerun1 by @kevin
jon: If rerun passes, we aim to tag rc2 at 19:00 PT and start canary at 20:00 PT.
maria: Great. Keep updates short here. If anything blocks, escalate. :rocket:
